description: Frontend ticket picker + Test Connection buttons + spec-doc sync, consuming the FEAT-001 backend. Adds the itop/n8n groups to useApi, the ItopTicketModal component, rewrites the four ACL/Route add/delete pages (ticket picker, required changeTicket, button gating, REMOVE the `as *Input` cast), adds the Administration Test Connection buttons, verifies the already-applied User-Mapping pagination (5), and updates the specs. Depends on FEAT-001 (calls /api/itop/* and /api/n8n/test, imports itop.schema types). Grounded in design.md §10, §11, §13, §14. Removing the four `as *Input` casts is what turns the required-changeTicket change into a compile-time guarantee (design §4.1/§14).
steps: Read .agents/tasks/itop-ticket-integration/context.json AND design.md IN FULL first; also read FEAT-001.json findings. context.json replaces re-exploration.

app/composables/useApi.ts: add the itop group (searchTickets(q,limit=20)->POST /api/itop/tickets/search, getTicket(ref)->POST /api/itop/tickets/preview, testConnection()->POST /api/itop/test) and n8n group (testConnection()->POST /api/n8n/test), all via apiSend. Import ItopTicketSummary, ItopTicketDetail, ConnectionTestResult from #shared/schemas/itop.schema.

app/components/ItopTicketModal.vue (NEW, design §10.2): UModal (pattern from DeviceCredentialsModal.vue) with forced-light search UInput (color=neutral variant=outline :ui base bg-panel text-ink ring-line placeholder:text-muted) + brand search button + Enter-to-search; results list (ref mono + type pill + truncated title) via useApi().itop.searchTickets; the three shared states LoadingState / EmptyState (icon i-lucide-ticket) / ErrorState (retry); preview card via itop.getTicket(ref); a 'Use this ticket' brand button emitting selected. Props { modelValue: boolean }; emits update:modelValue + selected [ItopTicketSummary]. XSS: render EVERY iTop string via {{ }} ONLY — NO v-html, no raw-HTML sink (§10.2/R6). Token classes only; icon-only buttons get aria-label; do NOT restyle FormField.

Rewrite each of app/pages/acl/add.vue, acl/delete.vue, routes/add.vue, routes/delete.vue (design §10.3): (a) swap the raw changeTicket <input> for a readonly display (:value, placeholder 'No ticket selected') + 'Select ticket' UButton, add <ItopTicketModal v-model=ticketModalOpen @selected=onTicketSelected/>; keep label 'Ticket Change' + name 'changeTicket', add required; (b) add ticketModalOpen, selectedTicket, onTicketSelected (sets form.changeTicket = t.ref); (c) in buildPayload() send changeTicket: form.changeTicket and REMOVE the `as AclPreviewInput`/`as RoutePreviewInput` cast (prefer no annotation; fall back to `satisfies`; never `as` — §4.1); (d) append `|| !form.changeTicket` to the Generate button's EXISTING :disabled (ACL: generating || !ipsValid || !form.changeTicket; Route: generating || !ipValid || !form.changeTicket — do NOT use && !!form.changeTicket); (e) add text-muted helper note 'Select a change ticket to enable Generate.' when !form.changeTicket; (f) clear selectedTicket.value = null in resetFields(). Do NOT modify the existing watch(form, ...).

app/pages/administration/index.vue (design §11): add a v-if=canManage 'Connections' section after the <Pagination> block with two neutral-outline UButtons (i-lucide-plug; labels 'Test iTop Connection' / 'Test n8n Connection'; per-button :loading). Merge the existing useApi destructure to `const { users, roles: rolesApi, itop, n8n } = useApi()` (do NOT add a 2nd useApi() call); add itopTesting/n8nTesting refs and testItop/testN8n handlers reusing the page's existing notifySuccess/notifyError toast helpers and errorMessage.

Verify (NO edit) User-Mapping pagination: confirm `const ITEMS_PER_PAGE = 5` and that <Pagination v-if=total>ITEMS_PER_PAGE> + users.list({page, limit: ITEMS_PER_PAGE}) are wired in app/pages/administration/index.vue (already applied, design §11.1).

Spec docs (design §13): .kiro/specs/n8n-integration/requirements.md add EARS R1-R17; .kiro/specs/n8n-integration/design.md note changeTicket now REQUIRED + carries selected iTop ref and add a 'Device Session Credentials' sibling subsection for the ticket picker + pingN8n/pingItop test endpoints; .kiro/specs/netops-policy-manager/design.md add itop.schema.ts to Zod schemas, the four /api/itop/* + /api/n8n/test rows to the API Endpoints table, ItopTicketModal.vue to Frontend Components, and ITOP_DATABASE_URL + ITOP_TIMEOUT_MS to config/env. Do NOT touch Log Trail code or audit read endpoints.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run typecheck` passes with 0 errors — the four buildPayload() now satisfy the required changeTicket with NO cast (this is the compile-time safety net from §14).
Each of the four pages' buildPayload() sends `changeTicket: form.changeTicket` with NO `|| undefined` and NO `as *Input` cast; the Generate button is disabled while !form.changeTicket.

ItopTicketModal renders all iTop-sourced strings via {{ }} only (no v-html / raw-HTML sink); uses only ui-conventions token classes and shared LoadingState/EmptyState/ErrorState; FormField is not restyled.
Administration Test Connection buttons are visible only when canManage; ITEMS_PER_PAGE is confirmed = 5.
verification: User runs `npm run typecheck` — expect 0 errors.
User runs `npm run build` — expect success.
Confirm via reading the four pages that buildPayload() has no `|| undefined` and no `as *Input` cast on changeTicket, and ITEMS_PER_PAGE = 5 in administration/index.vue.
